title: SharedReceiptV1
description: Canonical shared receipt schema bridging wasm4pm and mcpp. Resolves three type-drift risks: (1) run ID attribute name, (2) timing asymmetry, (3) hash scheme prefix.

run_id.description: Canonical run identifier (UUID v4). Maps from wasm4pm Receipt.run_id and mcpp AcceptedResponse.run_id.

schema_version.description: Schema version sentinel for this shared format.

start_time.description: Execution start (ISO 8601). Maps from wasm4pm start_time; mcpp started_at.

end_time.description: Execution end (ISO 8601). Maps from wasm4pm end_time; derived in mcpp as started_at + duration_ms.

status.description: Execution outcome. Accepts both wasm4pm values (success/partial/failed) and mcpp verdict values (accepted/refused).

hash_format.description: Sentinel declaring that all hash fields in this document carry bare 64-character lowercase hex strings (no 'blake3:' prefix). Risk 3 mitigation: the prefix is stripped on ingestion from mcpp transport refs.

hashes.description: BLAKE3 hashes of pipeline artifacts. All values are bare 64-char hex (no prefix).

proof_pack.description: Hash of the proof pack. Maps from mcpp ProofPackRef.hash (blake3: prefix stripped).

chain_predecessor.description: Chain linkage: literal 'genesis' for the first receipt, or bare 64-char hex of the predecessor receipt hash. Risk 3 mitigation: the 'blake3:' prefix is stripped on ingestion from mcpp ReceiptRef.chain_predecessor.

otel_run_id_attribute.description: Risk 1 mitigation: records which OTel attribute name the originating system used. wasm4pm emits 'run.id'; mcpp emits 'mcpp.run_id'. Consumers can use this to look up the span attribute without guessing.

conformance.description: Conformance dimension scores (0.0–1.0). Maps from mcpp ConformanceThresholds.

source.description: Which system produced this shared receipt, for audit and provenance purposes.
